subject: Captain Tolub
fact: Captain Tolub betrayed the party by sending them into a trap at the fire temple instead of connecting them with Romag of the Earth Temple.
source_quote: They had been betrayed by Captain Tolub, who sent them into a trap at the fire temple instead of connecting them with Romag of the Earth Temple as promised.

subject: Captain Tolub
fact: Captain Tolub told everyone he had disposed of the party, claiming they were meddlers who didn't belong.
source_quote: Skole revealed that Tolub had been telling everyone he had disposed of the party, claiming they were meddlers who didn't belong.

subject: Albreth
fact: Albreth, a fire priest, unleashed devastating magical flames upon the party.
source_quote: Fire priests Albreth and Ingulf had unleashed devastating magical flames upon them.

subject: Ingulf
fact: Ingulf, a fire priest, unleashed devastating magical flames upon the party.
source_quote: Fire priests Albreth and Ingulf had unleashed devastating magical flames upon them.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was nearly killed by the fire temple's magical flames but was revived by Zephyr's magical dust.
source_quote: nearly killing Calmer before Zephyr’s quick thinking with magical dust allowed them to vanish and flee into the darkness.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer declared he was done being the face of the party and wanted to rely on infiltration and stealth instead of direct confrontation.
source_quote: Calmer... declared he was done being the face of the party, tired of looking like a fool and nearly getting killed. The party’s strength, he argued, lay in infiltration and stealth, not direct confrontation.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr used magical dust to allow the party to vanish and flee from the fire temple.
source_quote: Zephyr’s quick thinking with magical dust allowed them to vanish and flee into the darkness.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia found the party a well-hidden cave to rest in and carefully obscured their tracks.
source_quote: Zinnia’s expertise proved invaluable as he found them a well-hidden cave to rest in and carefully obscured their tracks.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa noticed the gnolls dressed in fire temple garb seemed to be on patrol.
source_quote: Sequioa noticed the gnolls seemed to be on patrol, possibly looking for the party themselves or dealing with the various bandit factions that plagued the region.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa picked up the bandit chief muttering about recruiting gnolls from the local gnoll king for the fire temple.
source_quote: Sequioa’s keen hearing picked up the chief muttering complaints about recruiting gnolls from the local gnoll king for the fire temple.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole, the bartender at the Boatman’s Tavern, was shocked to see the party alive.
source_quote: Skole, the bartender, was visibly shocked to see them alive.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole despised both Tolub and Lodriss and wished to be free of them both.
source_quote: Skole confided that he despised both Tolub and Lodriss, the tavern’s actual owner, and wished to be free of them both.

subject: Skole
fact: Skole told the party they needed to speak with Dick Rentsch at the Waterside Hostel to contact the Earth Temple.
source_quote: he told them that if they wanted to contact the Earth Temple, they needed to speak with Dick Rentsch at the Waterside Hostel, not Tolub, who worked for the fire prophet.

subject: Elfar Twell
fact: Elfar Twell was executed on the gallows by order of Madame Selentis for crossing her.
source_quote: they saw a dead man hanging from the gallows—Elfar Twell, executed on the orders of the powerful Madame Selentis for the crime of crossing her.

subject: Madame Selentis
fact: Madame Selentis ordered the execution of Elfar Twell for crossing her.
source_quote: executed on the orders of the powerful Madame Selentis for the crime of crossing her.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch is the proprietor of the Waterside Hostel and a contact for the Earth Temple.
source_quote: they met Dick Rentsch. The gruff proprietor sized them up with suspicion... When the party mentioned they had something of interest for the Earth Temple, Dick Rentsch’s demeanor shifted to excitement.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch told the party they needed to ambush and kill a group of gnolls and their handlers to earn his trust and the prophet’s favor.
source_quote: he explained that to earn his trust and the prophet’s favor, they needed to complete a mission: ambush and kill a group of gnolls and their handlers who were being recruited for the fire temple that very night.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat, the bartender at the Waterside Hostel, attempted to extract information about the party’s business.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat warned the party not to drink the beer and served them gin instead.

subject: Wat

fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil is structured around four cults led by prophets: Romag of Earth, Belsornig of Water, and two unnamed leaders of Fire and Air.
